summary: Observational, access-driven documentary-vlog: the camera rides along in cars, waits at doors, and sits at tables with a politician's circle. It is punctuated by black interstitial title cards ('ZERO TO £100M' series branding at 0:30, 'THE NEXT DAY' at 3:27) and pieces to camera that explain stakes. Burned-in subtitles carry the dialogue. The grade is warm with magenta/orange highlights, shallow depth of field on people, and handheld fly-on-the-wall framing.
hook_analysis: In medias res: the film opens inside a moving car and on campaign activity before the series title card; context is given only after the viewer is already 'in the room'.
narrative_arc: Day-by-day chronology signposted by text cards ('THE NEXT DAY'); stakes are set by a piece to camera ('He's running for president and I'm here to support him'); scenes alternate private moments (car, dinner) with public ones (community events).
camera_and_composition: Observational handheld; car-interior profiles against windows; shallow-focus medium close-ups for pieces to camera; dashboard POV of the street.
color_and_grade: Warm, slightly magenta-shifted highlights; lifted shadows; skin tones prioritised.
sound_and_music: Not measurable here (no captions available, and audio is not downloaded).
what_to_borrow: Black text interstitials to mark time jumps
One crisp piece to camera to state the stakes early
Ride-along car scenes as connective tissue between locations
what_to_avoid_copying: Series branding cards - use your own title system
